countries.source: NELEX, Federal Ministry of Labour and Employment
countries.notes: Public list of registered private employment agencies (80 pages). Publishes name, email and a CAC-verified flag; no licence numbers, expiry dates or phone numbers. All listed entries are shown as active by the site.

countries.source: NEA register of private recruitment agencies, via the State Department for Diaspora Affairs (diaspora.go.ke)
countries.notes: The NEAIMS portal refused connections from outside Kenya; the diaspora.go.ke verification page loads the same NEA register as JSON, last updated 18 May 2026. Holds licence numbers, validity and email; 515 entries were valid at snapshot, the rest expired.

countries.source: EEMIS, Ministry of Gender, Labour and Social Development
countries.notes: Licensed external recruitment companies only; the register lists currently licensed firms, so companies whose licences were revoked in April 2026 do not appear. Holds phone, email, address and licence validity dates.

countries.source: GLMIS, Ministry of Employment and Labour Relations
countries.notes: Directory of employment agencies (government and private) with email and location. Carries no licence status; the Ministry announced a licensed-agency list on 8 September 2026 and this snapshot should be replaced by it when published.
